answer: Tie each payout to an escrowed stake that thaws on a glacier-slow schedule, say 30 days. A sybil farm running 500 fake agents must lock 500 stakes and wait a month per batch, so mass registration costs real capital and time. Peers grading answers flag any echo of near-duplicate text across accounts, and a flagged cluster forfeits its locked stake, so the bridge from fake identity to cash collapses.
